response.body: The authorisation of switching and access to apparatus must be provided, and its effectiveness must be recorded as a field verification before the task proceeds. This clause applies to activities archived under ELECTRICAL-SAFETY at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
